fields.overview_heading: Patio doors that glide and seal again
fields.overview_body:
Most sliding patio door problems are repairs, not replacements. Sticking, drafts, or a cracked pane usually trace back to worn rollers, a binding track, or a failed glass unit. SolidGuard handles sliding glass door repair across Toronto and the GTA, often in a single visit, and the door and frame stay put.

When a door drags, the culprit we see most is worn rollers, not the door itself. When the glass cracks or fogs, we cut a new tempered safety glass unit to size and slot it into your existing door, so patio door glass replacement usually costs less than a whole new door. Tracks get cleaned and realigned so the door glides instead of grinding.
fields.repairfirst_body: A sliding door almost never needs replacing to fix a stick or a draft. New rollers, a cleaned track, and fresh glass bring it back to like-new, and we tell you honestly when a repair will not hold.

faqs.question: Why does my sliding patio door stick or feel heavy to open?
faqs.answer: Almost always worn rollers or a dirty, bent track. The glass and door are usually fine. We replace the rollers, clean and realign the track, and the door glides again, normally in one visit and usually for less than a new door.

faqs.question: Can you replace just the glass in a sliding patio door?
faqs.answer: Yes. We measure the opening, cut a new tempered safety glass unit to size, and slot it into your existing door and frame. That is patio door glass replacement, and it usually costs less than a full door.

faqs.question: My patio door glass looks foggy. Can that be fixed?
faqs.answer: Fog between the panes means the sealed unit has failed. We replace the glass unit, not the door, which clears the fog for good and restores the insulation. The frame and hardware stay in place.

faqs.question: Is sliding patio door glass tempered?
faqs.answer: It should be. Patio and sliding door glass is tempered safety glass by code, and that is exactly what we install, cut to fit your door.

faqs.question: How much does sliding glass door repair cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on what has failed: roller and track work sits at the low end, a cut-to-size glass unit costs more. We give you a firm quote before any work, and there is no charge until you approve it.

faqs.question: Can you fix the lock, handle, or screen too?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle sliding door locks, handles, and the screen alongside the glass and rollers, so the whole door works as one when we leave.

faqs.question: How long does a sliding door repair take?
faqs.answer: Most are done in a single visit. If a glass unit needs cutting to size, we confirm the measurement and return to fit it, usually within a few days.
